text: Beneath the spreading canopy, the beasts of the savanna gathered in solemn council.
Wise Elephant raised her broad ears and spoke with the measured cadence of an elder: 'Brothers and sisters, lamenting will not bring clouds to our sky.
Deep within the riverbed sleeps sweet water.
If every creature gives paw, tusk, or claw, we shall drink before twilight.'
Beside her, the Hare smoothed his whiskers, looking sideways with quiet cunning.
